- KPIs: average latency < 300ms p95, stable cost under agreed budget, and no PII exfiltration.
- Deliverables: mutual action plan (attached), pricing sheet (attached).

A few items we need from your side to finalize pricing and credits:
1) Token volume estimates (approx): average tokens/day, monthly run-rate, and peak tokens/day.
2) Target budget range for the pilot (monthly) and any guardrails for spend.
3) Target unit economics — is there a target $/1M tokens you want to hit for a production roll?

We have an internal credits program for pilots — if you can share the expected burn rate (tokens/day and avg tokens per call) we can size a free-credit allocation and timeline.

Next steps I propose:

Thanks — quick SE take on burn and cost levers. High level observations based on the numbers Logan shared:

- Baseline: 2M tokens/day => ~60M/month. At our hosted volume tier (~$45 / 1M) that implies ~$2,700 / month (60 * 45) — note: that math is illustrative because we price on tiered bands and have per-request overhead.
- Peak days at 5M tokens/day would push weekly burn up substantially; recommend rate-limiting on non-critical calls and caching for repeated user prompts.

Immediate optimizations (low lift):
- Prompt trimming: reduce system prompt + template length; replace large context with embeddings lookup where possible.
- Per-call token cap: enforce 1,000 token cap on generation until we evaluate quality impact.
- Batch/rerank optimization: switch to batched rerank API to amortize overhead.
- KV prefix caching: for personalization, cache KV for common prefixes to avoid regen.

Projected unit economics with optimizations:
- Conservative: 60M/mo @ $45/1M => ~$2,700/mo.
- Optimized (30% token reduction via prompt + caching): 42M/mo @ effective $45/1M => ~$1,890/mo.
- Dedicated-reserved path: dedicated pool + quantization => unit cost ~$20–30/1M at 200M+ monthly run rates.

Recommendation: approve the $5k credit now (Marissa confirmed) and grant the extra $10k if we see sustained pilot activity over the next 7 days. I’ll set up a short runbook for the engineering team on the caching/batch changes.

-Vivek
